molecular_expression_transform: library-size to sample median + log1p; all genes retained

functional_prior.resource_discovery: resources/**/*.gmt with GO/MSigDB functional naming; signaling-named GMT excluded
functional_prior.resource_layer_normalization: divide by median positive weighted degree
functional_prior.layer_combination: equal mean across used functional resources

signaling.duplicate_evidence: one canonical biological edge with merged evidence

block_normalization: Level-0 median/IQR frozen for entire later trajectory
